procedure: Pages rendered with pdfplumber page.to_image(resolution=220); the five pages are PORTRAIT sheets whose rotated landscape tables read upright after PIL ROTATE_270 ('November General Election for 11/3/2026' banner -- cache/2026-scan-assessment/tier1/webster/). Every in-scope row's cross-page cell sum equals its printed TOTAL exactly (13/13).
structure_note: Five-page shape: p1 the certification/signature page; p2+p3 = table A over the county's 14 precincts (11 columns, then Mathiston No. 4/Tormolen/Walthall + TOTAL) carrying Senate, House 1, CoA 1, and Chancery 6's Place 1 section header at the p3 bottom; p4+p5 = table B over the same column split carrying Chancery 6 Place 2 (Kiley Catledge Kirk's row LEADING table B ahead of the 'Chancery Court 6-...Place 2' header box printed below it -- the Chancery 6 Place 2 carry, its header printed as p3's last box), Circuit 5's Places 1-2, and the local school-board rows. Races: U.S. Senate; US House Of Rep 01-1st Congressional District (Johnny Baucom, Cliff Johnson, Trent Kelly -- the House 1 roster, names identical); Court Of Appeals 01-District 1 Position 1 (Derek Dewayne Hopson Jr., John Weddle) and Position 2 (Donna M. Barnes) -- the same CoA 1 roster, names identical; Chancery Court 6-Chancery District 06 Place 1 (Doug S. Crosby), Place 2 (Kiley Catledge Kirk) -- the same Chancery 6 roster seven counties print, names identical (SEVENTH county); Circuit Court 5-Circuit District 05 Place 1 (Joseph H. 'Joey' Loper Jr.) and Place 2 (Alan D. 'Devo' Lancaster) -- the same Circuit 5 roster five counties print, names identical. Printed totals: Colom 957, Hyde-Smith 2853, Pinkins 82, Baucom 54, Johnson 874, Kelly 2958, Hopson 682, Weddle 2930, Barnes 3225, Crosby 3231, Kirk 3210, Loper 3314, Lancaster 3072.
operator_rows_note: All 13 in-scope rows supplied by operator_rows in ballot order; table-A rows carry p2+p3 cells + the p3 printed TOTAL; Kirk's, Loper's and Lancaster's rows carry p4+p5 cells + the p5 printed TOTAL. The X-celled school-board rows are local and contribute no parse rows.
truncation_note: No truncations; the fourteen precinct headers print complete (Bellefontaine, Big Black, Clarkson, Cumberland, Eupora No. 1, Eupora No. 2, Eupora No. 3, Grady, Maben, Mantee, Mathiston No. 3, Mathiston No. 4, Tormolen, Walthall -- the sheet's own numbered-township forms kept verbatim).
local_note: p4/p5 carry the local sections after Circuit 5 Place 2: 'School Board District 2-School Board District 2' (Bailey Stewart King, X-celled outside Bellefontaine/South Kirklin) and 'School Board District 5-School Board District 5' (Gabriella 'Gabby' Davis) -- local, out of scope, contributing no parse rows on operator-supply pages. Chancery 6's printed Places are 1 and 2 (no Place 3 section), so the family writes Place-qualified labels (matching the other Chancery 6 counties); Circuit 5's two Places likewise (matching the Circuit 5 counties).
